senses.gloss: f. (contr. of <cite ref="A00568"><he>אוּדְנָא</he></cite>, cmp. however <cite ref="A00716"><he>אָוֶן</he></cite>)

units: <cite ref="Chullin 38a:1">Ib. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>אזוזי א׳</he> moving the ears (as a sign of life in the last stages).
<cite ref="Yevamot 60b:19">Yeb. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>מפיקנא … מאוניך</he> we shall get R. … out of thy ears, i.e. we shall make thee give up thy authority (a threat of excommunication).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45:7">Gen. R. s. 45</cite> <he>אוניך דחמר</he> thy ears are those of an ass.—

<cite ref="Chullin 47a:2">Ḥull. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ אוני וכ׳</he> the lungs have five lobes; a. fr. [Later Rabb. literature uses <cite ref="A00686"><he>אוּמָא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="A00685"><he>אוּם</he></cite>, for the large lump from which the lobes branch off.] V. <cite ref="A00743"><he>אוּנִין</he></cite>.
